title: fix(service-automation): the two-package flow collision line says neither flow is armed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9ENWEBFHM19dDwc5CiBumP9)_
Fixes #31754

Clause-②: no — log text only; what the engine arms, refuses or runs does not change. Measured on head ea1c60cf on a real cold boot (ObjectKernel + ObjectQLPlugin + SqlDriver): in all three refused shapes the engine refuses the name and arms nothing, the same as on base; only the collision line and its meta change. `engine.ts` is not in the diff, and the returned winner and `FlowShadowingRecord` are unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：启动日志里「流程名冲突」那一行，现在先问引擎用的同一个包作用域解析器。解析器拒绝这个名字时（另有一个包也发了同名流程），这一行写「两个都不启用」，日志附带的 meta 也不再写 armed。
- 为什么改：E1（#31738）后引擎对这类名字一个都不启用，但日志在三种情形下仍写「启用了 X」：两个包、两个包加覆盖件、两个包加一条存储行。
- 风险与回滚：只改日志文字和 meta，引擎行为不变；解析器放行的名字、以及没接解析器的组合，日志逐字节同 main。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-precedence.ts`（`refusalOf` 分支），`plugin.ts` 的 `resolveFlowContenders`，再看 `flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts -t 31754`，预期 7 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The boot pull's collision warning (`resolveFlowPrecedence`) now asks the resolver the engine asks. Following the seat's ruling (A, card comment 6732521115):

- `resolveFlowPrecedence` takes an optional fifth argument, `refusalOf(name)` (type `FlowNameRefusalReader`, exported as a type from the package root). It returns the refusal message the engine's flow-name resolver gives `name` for a caller with no package, or `undefined` when it serves the name.
- `AutomationServicePlugin.resolveFlowContenders` (the one precedence path for the boot pull, the `kernel:ready` sync and the `metadata:reloaded` re-sync) fills it from `flowNameResolver(ctx)`, the same reader `init()` attaches to the engine (`setFlowNameResolver`), so the warning says "refused" exactly when `registerFlow` refuses.
- When the resolver refuses, every arm reads, instead of "arming FIRST …":

```text
[Automation] Flow name collision: 'NAME' is claimed by N definitions (CONTENDERS); arming neither: the engine refuses this bare name for a caller with no package (ADR-0150 D3), so no definition dispatches; the 'failed to register flow' warning for 'NAME' names every holder. Rename one of them.
```

  ("arming none of them" when three or more definitions are listed), and the warning's meta is `{ flow, refused: true, contenders }` (no `armed`, no `shadowed`).
- When the resolver serves the name, or no resolver is attached, every arm's line and meta are byte for byte main's.

Measured on base f6474306 with a real cold boot (the round-2 report, 6732507604), three shapes in which the engine refuses while main's line said a flow was armed:

| Shape | main's line | Engine | This PR |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| two packages | "arming package 'A' by package id" | refuses, arms nothing | arming neither |
| the declared override (A's `.custom`) beside a second package | "arming the declared override in 'A.custom' …" | refuses, arms nothing | arming neither / arming none of them |
| two packages plus a package-less stored row | "arming package 'A' because a managed package's flow is sealed" | refuses, arms nothing | arming neither / arming none of them |

The shadowing record and its three readers (the bootstrap restatement in `plugin.ts`, the CLI banner via `serve.ts`/`format.ts`, `armedFrom` on runtime states) are unchanged: measured on the dogfood showcase boot holding a two-package clash, the engine records no receipt for a refused name (`getShadowedFlows()` is `[]`, no runtime-state row, no "is ARMED" line), because the boot pull records it only after `registerFlow` succeeds.

Pinned strings, found by searching the tree for "by package id", "arming", "Flow name collision" and "other definition(s)":

- `packages/cli/src/utils/format.boot-warning-classes.test.ts` (print-once case): **forced test change.** Its collision record paired a package with a runtime row (the sealed class) but spelled the "by package id" arm. It now carries the line the sealed class prints. The assertions (one collision record kept, the restatement withheld) are unchanged. Because this PR edits the file, `check:test-source-alias` judged its reach and asked for ten module-top side-effect imports (the dynamic `import()`s `serve.ts` reaches), the same block `dev-mcp-connect-hint-origin.test.ts` carries; added, gate green.
- `flow-name-shadowing.test.ts`, `flow-precedence-loader-set.test.ts`: pin the sealed and override arms with no resolver; unchanged and green.
- `flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts`: its boot helper gains an optional second package (`Second`: none, before or after the shipping package); every existing case passes `none` by default and is unchanged.

## Tests

- **Pins, real cold boot** (new top-level describe `[#31754]` in `flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts`): the three shapes above × the second package registered before and after the shipping one (6 cases). Each asserts the engine's refusal (every 'failed to register flow' record for the name says "held by 2 packages" and names both packages; `getFlow` null before and after `kernel:ready`; no receipt) and that every collision line for the name agrees ("arming neither"/"arming none of them", the pointer, no "arming package / the declared override / a runtime-authored", no "Only the armed definition dispatches"; meta `refused: true` without `armed`).
- **CONTROL, a name the resolver serves**: one package plus a package-less row on the same real boot; the line is `toBe` main's sealed line, the meta is main's, nothing refused, the base armed.
- **CONTROL, no resolver** (E1 harness, `flow-package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`): the four arms (by package id, sealed, declared override, arrival order), each `toBe` main's line.
- **Pin, E1 harness**: two packages in both registration orders, with `refusalOf` built as the plugin builds it; line `toBe` the new text, and the engine refuses naming both.

## Acceptance notes

- **Correction.** An earlier revision of this body said that two packages plus an environment row keep a true "arming package …" line, because the resolver answers a caller with no package with the environment row. That was **reasoned from the resolver's code, not measured, and it is wrong**: on a real cold boot the engine refuses that name too (round-2 report 6732507604, shape 3 above). This revision covers it.
- The line asks `flowNameResolver(ctx)`, the reader `init()` attaches to the engine, not the engine itself (no new engine method). A host that attaches a different resolver to the engine by hand would bypass the plugin altogether; no such caller exists in this repository.
- `FlowNameRefusalReader` is a new exported type name (the optional parameter's type), named after the existing `FlowNameResolver`. Open question for the seat.

## Verification

Every reading below is on head ea1c60cf (the final commit), base f6474306.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: Test Files 267 passed (267), Tests 3493 passed (3493). `typecheck`: exit 0. Root `eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-automation`: exit 0 (the package has no `lint` script).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/utils/format.boot-warning-classes.test.ts src/commands/serve-automation-shadowing.test.ts`: 34 passed (34). The CLI `integration` tier is declared to CI.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 73 derived gates, each run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Full dogfood: not run (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm); the CI queue runs it.
